python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
ns = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
sheet = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
expenses = {}
for row in sheet.iter(ns+'row'):
    r = int(row.attrib['r'])
    cells = {c.attrib['r']: c for c in row.iter(ns+'c')}
    if r in range(11, 23):
        cat = next((t.text for t in cells['A%d'%r].iter(ns+'t')), '?')
        sub = next((t.text for t in cells['B%d'%r].iter(ns+'t')), '?')
        val = float(cells['C%d'%r].find(ns+'v').text)
        expenses.setdefault(cat, []).append((sub, val))
        print(f'{cat:16s} {sub:16s} \${val:,.2f}')
print()
total = 0
for cat, items in expenses.items():
    s = sum(v for _, v in items)
    total += s
    print(f'  {cat}: \${s:,.2f}')
print(f'  TOTAL EXPENSES: \${total:,.2f}')
print(f'  Formula check SUM(C11:C22) = {sum(v for items in expenses.values() for _, v in items):,.2f}')
"
